title: A Golden Spiral of Thermodynamic Histories: Characterizing Trajectories of Ice Crystals in Cirrus Clouds as Modeled by Particle-based Microphysics in CM1
testbed_rationale: Conference abstract without public data or code links.
extraction_notes: The abstract applies an unsupervised clustering technique to Lagrangian supersaturation trajectories of ice crystals simulated using CM1 large-eddy simulation with particle-based microphysics for an ICEBall (Ice Cryo-Encapsulation Balloon) cirrus cloud case. The cluster centroids lie along a squared golden spiral manifold parameterized by scalar theta.
